ITEM 1 | Cluster of small dark reddish-brown oval pieces, glossy and slightly wrinkled surface, roughly 1.5-2 cm long each, with a few having a smooth shiny skin, grouped in a loose heap in the lower-right area of a large white square plate; one small bright green leaf-like piece sits on top of the cluster near its upper edge | 45

ITEM 2 | Faint pinkish-red specks and smudges scattered on the white plate surface beside the cluster, thin and dry-looking, with no clear pooling or sheen | 2
